iq_a.note: SLVSB02B section 8.5: 360 nA typical, VIN 3.6 V, 25 °C, EN high, CTRL low, VOUT 1.8 V, no load, device not switching. Switching no-load IQ is 460 nA; LOAD enabled changes IQ. This fixed baseline is an approximation under load. https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps62740.pdf

min_input_v.note: Restricted model input threshold, not a measured UVLO characteristic. Output selection 1.8 V; CTRL held low so LOAD is disabled. Current rating 300 mA applies with VIN >= VOUT + 0.7 V. https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps62740.pdf

outputs.vout.voltage_v.note: Output selection 1.8 V; CTRL held low so LOAD is disabled. Current rating 300 mA applies with VIN >= VOUT + 0.7 V. https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps62740.pdf

outputs.vout.efficiency.note: Constant 0.90 conversion efficiency excluding separately modelled IQ. Illustrative estimate, not a datasheet efficiency curve; replace with characterized losses.

outputs.vout.max_current_a.note: Output selection 1.8 V; CTRL held low so LOAD is disabled. Current rating 300 mA applies with VIN >= VOUT + 0.7 V. https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps62740.pdf

outputs.vout.enabled.note: Selected operating configuration: regulator enabled; no startup or shutdown transition.
